## skenv version

Print the skenv version

```
skenv version [flags]
```

### Examples

```console
$ skenv version
skenv 0.5.0
commit: 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
built:  2026-09-01T12:00:00Z
```

### Options

```
  -h, --help   help for version
```
